plan.title: QCS Rejects Bid Above Price Ceiling

steps.note: Open the existing prepared live RFQ summary; this is the required starting point for a prepared event.
Navigate to the published event's Participants list so the vendor price cap can be configured.
Set Vendor A's maximum allowed price to 150 before revising the bid.
Verify that Vendor A's saved price ceiling is 150.
Use the invited vendor session to submit the bid value required by the scenario.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Revise Vendor A's bid to 200, which exceeds the saved ceiling of 150.
Return to the buyer's event page to inspect Master QCS.
Open Master QCS and assert that the comparison grid for Vendor A rendered.
